description: This file defines the Banner class within the Opencart admin controller event namespace. It contains methods to add, edit, and delete banner entities by creating tasks related to banner operations and interfacing with a setting task model.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: A controller class that handles event-related operations for banners, facilitating task creation for banner management actions.

methods.name: addBanner
methods.description: Creates a task to add a new banner, including generating a task data array and invoking the model's addTask method.

methods.name: editBanner
methods.description: Creates a task to edit an existing banner, preparing task data based on provided arguments.

methods.name: deleteBanner
methods.description: Creates a task to delete a banner, based on banner ID provided in arguments.
